items.source: NOTE: MongoDB Java Driver 5.7+ comes with observability directly built in which can be configured via MongoClientSettings.Builder#observabilitySettings(ObservabilitySettings). We recommend switching to the driver native observability.
items.translation: 注意：MongoDB Java 驱动程序 5.7 及以上版本内置了可观测性功能，可通过 MongoClientSettings.Builder#observabilitySettings(ObservabilitySettings) 进行配置。我们建议使用驱动程序原生的可观测性功能。

items.source: Create a ContextProvider given ObservationRegistry. The factory method attempts to create a ContextProvider that is capable to propagate request contexts across imperative or reactive usage, depending on their class path presence.
items.translation: 根据 `ObservationRegistry` 创建一个 `ContextProvider`。该工厂方法尝试创建一个能够根据类路径的存在情况，在命令式或响应式用法之间传播请求上下文的 `ContextProvider`。

items.source: since 5.1 in favor of native MongoDB Java Driver observability support.
items.translation: 自 5.1 版本起，支持原生 MongoDB Java Driver 的可观测性。

items.source: Factory to create a ContextProvider to propagate the request context across tasks. Requires either SynchronousContextProvider or ReactiveContextProvider to be present.
items.translation: 工厂用于创建 ContextProvider 以在任务之间传播请求上下文。需要存在 SynchronousContextProvider 或 ReactiveContextProvider 之一。
